verdict.claim: The bounded vector-adjustment capture identifies negative-projection removal at 0x007D75C5..0x007D75D3 as the retained-Y operation on all 261 source-change/publication-hold frames. Its nonzero input dY equaled the projection scalar bit-for-bit, its output was exact positive zero, recursion at 0x007D7779 received zero dY, and the terminal 0x007D77B2 writer received preceding RigidBodyY + 0.0. Threshold correction did not zero dY. Projection and recursion also occurred on non-held frames, so this is not a held-frame-only frame-rate gate. The observation neither proves the adjustment incorrect nor establishes a render-only correction seam: the RigidBody record remains shared physics/model state.

runtimeObservations.provenance: Maintainer-supplied bounded retail captures from 2026-09-14, each pinned above by SHA-256; decoded vector-adjustment observations are preserved in proxyAdjustmentRuntime. The local video is not repository evidence.
facts: Player Y advances at approximately 30 Hz while Present runs near 60 FPS.
The retail 30 FPS limit removes the visible player, nameplate, slope, and camera stepping.
CameraActor update 0x006195D0 runs once per presented frame and CameraActor+0x250 already yields smooth camera world Y at 60 FPS.
The fixed-function D3DTS_VIEW transform remains identity.
The local controlled object and its ModelObject were identified by comparing ModelObject+0x30 with the simultaneous player-state snapshot; the next-closest actor was materially farther away.
The local controlled tick, 0x00A5FF60, 0x00A61620, and 0x00BB7550 each ran once per Present on the captured route.

Across 533 transitions at 60 FPS, source Y changed 493 times and published Y changed 358 times; 135 source-change frames retained the preceding published Y. Across 321 transitions at 30 FPS, the counts were 259, 241, and 18 respectively.
Within each Present ordinal, the local controlled sample preceded 0x00A5FF60, which enclosed 0x00A61620 and 0x00BB7550.

Three exactly matched vertex-constant tasks used start register 0 and count 16 on observed player-draw frames; they ran before that ordinal's update and consumed a previously published drawable transform.
The local ModelObject did not enter 0x008DEC70, although its cached transform changed inside 0x00A5FF60 before drawable publication.
NamePlate+0x78..+0x84 and +0x98..+0xA4 did not change during either movement segment.
The follow-up capture identified the live local ModelObject vtable as 0x010653A4 and confirmed slots 7, 13, 25, and 26 as 0x00A61620, 0x008DE970, 0x008DE790, and 0x008DEC70.
Actor+0x18 was non-null, Actor+0x48 was non-null, and (Actor+0x48)+0x20 was null, proving that the local callback took the fallback slot-13 branch.

Across 436 aligned 60 FPS transitions, ModelObject+0x30 Y changed 400 times and drawable Y changed 297 times. On all 103 source-change/publication-hold frames, slot 13 received the preceding published Y and copied it over the newer ModelObject+0x30 Y.
Slot 25 rebuilt the cached transform after slot 13 and supplied the exact record passed to the Drawable setter; it did not introduce the held Y.

The controller follow-up identified the live RaptureCharacterController vtable 0x00FEE17C, RaptureCharacterProxy vtable 0x00FEE210, and RigidBody vtable 0x010A9878. Controller selector +0x0C was 1 on all 900 frames and its +0x10 value supplied the new Y to proxy slot 1 on every held frame.

Across the controller follow-up, ModelObject source Y changed on 455 transitions and the RigidBody indexed-record Y changed on 295; on the other 160 source-change transitions, 0x00AFA160 calls returning to 0x007D77B7 received and wrote the preceding RigidBody Y exactly, and 0x00A61130 later read that same Y.

Static listing places 0x007D77B7 immediately after the 0x00AFA160 call at 0x007D77B2 inside 0x007D70D0. That call adds the current RigidBody [X,Y,Z,1] record to the displacement supplied to the terminal helper invocation.
runtimeObservations.consequence: CameraActor, D3DTS_VIEW, aspect ratio, navmesh and collision-data changes, server movement, packets, and authoritative actor-coordinate changes remain outside this correction investigation.

provenance.inputBoundary: Maintainer-supplied decoded observations from the pinned bounded retail capture; no repository-local raw-capture decoder reproduces these observations.
provenance.identification: Component-wise ModelObject/player-state agreement and live vtable checks; observed heap identities are run-local and are not reusable filters.

proxyAdjustmentRuntime.method: Correlate Present ordinal and local object identity; delimit the final-writer segment ending at the last 0x007D77B2 -> 0x00AFA160 writer (return 0x007D77B7), separately from all events in that Present. Compare float32 dY and projection-scalar bits at the last 0x007D75C3 branch before recursion, result bits at 0x007D75D3, child dY at 0x007D7779, and paired terminal writer input/output against immediately preceding RigidBody and published Y. Record threshold-correction results at 0x007D7646 independently.

capture.unpairedReason: Simultaneous identity-filter changes between entry and return; none of these entries participates in the held-frame proof.

proxyAdjustmentRuntime.conclusion: Negative-projection removal uniquely introduced zero terminal dY on the captured held frames. Threshold correction never zeroed dY; no deeper recursion was observed. Projection/recursion also occurred on non-held source-change Presents, so this operation is not a held-frame-only cadence gate.
proxyAdjustmentRuntime.limitations: One bounded capture proves the observed arithmetic and operation attribution, not that the adjustment is incorrect, a timer owner, general behavior on all routes, or a safe render-only smoothing seam. The resolver, RigidBody writer, and indexed record remain shared physics/model state; absence of feedback is not proven.

functions.condition: If +0x1B0 bit 0x10 is set, calls 0x009157C0 with this and metadata 0x013587F0, then clears that bit. Reads the resulting state byte. The computed store requires state & 3 nonzero and FNSTSW AX / TEST AH,0x44 to leave PF set so JNP 0x00930150 is not taken. An ordinary equal comparison skips the store; an unordered result is not excluded by this test. Sets state bit 0x04 and calls 0x00953BA0 with the property record and the same metadata.

functions.behavior: ECX is this and the single stack argument is forwarded as input to 0x0092FD20. Ends with RET 4 at 0x0093043A. If byte this+0x158 is zero, conditionally writes zero to ActualWidth and ActualHeight and constructs a zero rectangle. Otherwise calls 0x0092FD20 at 0x00930412, passing a stack-local output rectangle, input and byte selectors from +0x24C/+0x24E. Both branches pass the resulting rectangle to 0x00939720 at 0x00930422.
functions.condition: The zero-height store at 0x009303B6 uses ESI=this+0x1AC from 0x0093037A. After the optional metadata refresh/bit-0x10 clear, it requires +0x1B0 & 3 nonzero and FCOM / FNSTSW AX / TEST AH,0x44 to leave PF set so JNP 0x009303D0 is not taken. An ordinary equal comparison skips the store; an unordered result is not excluded. It sets bit 0x04 and notifies 0x00953BA0 with metadata 0x013587F0. The meaning of +0x158 is not promoted.

Slot 1 subtracts the current RigidBody record from its absolute input and passes the [dX,dY,dZ,0] displacement through 0x007D77E0. That dispatcher normalizes and segments the displacement and calls recursive helper 0x007D70D0.

Inside 0x007D70D0, opaque record vectors can remove a negative projection component from the displacement and add a thresholded correction along a record vector. On each captured held-Y transition, the 0x007D77B2 writer input Y equaled the preceding RigidBody Y. Therefore the terminal adjusted displacement Y was zero. The function did not load a retained Y as an alternative value; it reconstructed it as current Y plus zero displacement Y.
